mapper.sql: id, fee_code, fee_name, fee_type, unit_price, unit, charge_cycle, late_fee_rate, status, remark, create_time

where.if: AND (fee_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR fee_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_standard (fee_code, fee_name, fee_type, unit_price, unit, charge_cycle, late_fee_rate, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{feeCode}, #{feeName}, #{feeType}, IFNULL(#{unitPrice}, 0), #{unit}, IFNULL(#{chargeCycle}, 'MONTH'), IFNULL(#{lateFeeRate}, 0.0005), IFNULL(#{status}, 1), #{remark}, NOW())
